claims.statement: All registered candidates are generated and evaluated before clustering, and every presentation remains in the membership ledger.
claims.scope: The complete 576-presentation #966 budget-(2,2) census evaluated through #984.
assumptions: The pinned #966 enumerator and #984 evaluator are authoritative at their registered finite scope.
Stable presentation IDs and canonical codes identify retention rows.
falsifiers: Any generated presentation lacks exactly one membership row.
counterexample_methods: Inject a clustering callback into generation.
limits: No scalable generation or search-law claim.
Deduplication is used only for the clustering carrier, not candidate deletion.

claims.statement: The frozen 15/2 threshold graph gives a deterministic complete connected-component partition with deterministic medoids.
claims.scope: The 47 distinct #984 morphology records under base weights (5,3,2).
assumptions: Threshold, weights, canonical serialization, and medoid tie-break were frozen before implementation.
falsifiers: Primary traversal disagrees with independent union-find.
Components overlap or omit a record.
counterexample_methods: Use a malformed asymmetric distance matrix in the oracle.
limits: One operational clustering, not cluster truth.
No natural, unique, or unbiased taxonomy claim.

claims.statement: Four supplied reference fingerprints are loaded only after taxonomy-blind clustering and mapped by exact medoid fingerprint equality.
claims.scope: Protocol blindness relative to the frozen four-entry registry.
assumptions: Module separation and the source-token audit enforce the declared information boundary.
falsifiers: A registry token or mapper import appears in causal core.
A family label changes an edge/component/medoid.
counterexample_methods: Move a supplied label into causal code.
Call the mapper before clusters complete.
limits: Not family discovery or architecture-prior-free recovery.

claims.statement: Zero or multiple exact reference matches return explicit UNKNOWN, with no nearest-label fallback.
claims.scope: The frozen four-reference post-hoc registry and protected medoid fingerprints.
assumptions: Registry rows and medoid fingerprints satisfy the validated schema.
falsifiers: An unmatched fingerprint receives a known label.
An ambiguous fingerprint receives a known label.
counterexample_methods: Duplicate a matching reference under a second label.
limits: UNKNOWN is registry-relative non-identification, not ontological novelty.
No claim that all natural families are represented.

claims.statement: The partition is equivariant under all 120 certified surface remints and stable under the frozen #984 metric perturbation; medoids and labels also remain stable by aggregate margins/componentwise ties.
claims.scope: The registered 47-record carrier, threshold 15/2, certified remints, and weights (5,3,2) to (501/100,299/100,201/100).
assumptions: Only certified encode/decode surface remints count.
falsifiers: A medoid changes despite the registered certificate.
claims.strongest_parent: PR #984 finite remint and perturbation stability
limits: No arbitrary remint, metric, threshold, or large-scale robustness.
The out-of-bound hostile changes the partition.

open_gaps.statement: Large-scale clustering and sampling validity remain untested.
Alternative clusterers and threshold sensitivity beyond the single registered hostile remain unstudied.
The supplied four-entry reference registry is not a complete architecture taxonomy.
Historical architecture recovery and genuine unknown-form validation remain unclaimed.
Morphology-zoo and real-scale work in #220/#221 is untouched.
